description: The AGENTS.md pointer's warnings (Claude Code and Codex, hook trusted, project_doc_max_bytes = 200): a ~/.codex/AGENTS.md with malformed markers gets no pointer – a warning naming the marker, the rules file still written; a project AGENTS.md over the limit gets the pointer and a warning that it may be cut off; an AGENTS.override.md beside it, that Codex reads it instead. The resync warns the same; the CLI's resync text.
